snippet.title: Zukarii: The Descent - Alpha v0.3.0 Gameplay - Isometric Dungeon Crawler ARPG
snippet.description:
A look at Zukarii: The Descent alpha v0.3.0 (The Isometric Update), an indie isometric dungeon crawler ARPG in development.

In this clip, a level 34 Character pushes through dungeon tier 39 with a , battling goblins, an Orc Chieftain and a Wraith in the fortress of Zukarath.

What’s shown:
🔥 Elemental combat with damage types and weaknesses (the Wraith takes bonus fire damage)
🩸 Life Steal and Mana Drain affixes keeping the mage alive
⚔️ ARPG-style loot with item levels, randomized stats and named gear
🗺️ Procedurally generated isometric dungeon levels
🌀 Skill hot bar, portals, mini-map and a tabbed combat/loot log

Zukarii is built from scratch in vanilla JavaScript with a custom ECS engine. It’s still early in development and all graphics are placeholder, so expect things to change a lot before release.

▶ Play free in your browser: https://game.zukarii.com
▶ itch.io: https://leith42.itch.io/zukarii
▶ Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/Zukarii/1109837
▶ Discord: https://discord.gg/jWyMSQUbcK
▶ Website: https://zukarii.com

Developed by Targetship Games – https://targetship.games

#Zukarii #ARPG #DungeonCrawler #IndieGame #Gamedev
